### Before merging

Merging to `main` releases the change. Installs sync it within minutes.

- [ ] Offline tests pass in CI.
- [ ] A change to `the-source.js` or `schoology.js` ran live on its school site, signed in to a real parent account.
- [ ] A fix for a school site change updates its navigation guide in `docs/`.
- [ ] No names, schools, IDs, grades or other personal data, in code, fixtures or commit messages.
